vault.starter.content:
# Getting started

This folder holds your project docs as plain Markdown files. Edit this one or add more with any editor; xDev keeps a search index on this computer.

Every edit shows up under Changes. Approve it there to save it to the folder's history.

settings.repos.title: Repos
settings.repos.intro: A repo's short name is the prefix docs use in covers, such as xdev:src/**.
settings.repos.empty: No repos yet. Add one from the sidebar.
settings.repos.shortNameNote: Renaming moves no worktree folder and rewrites no doc: existing folders keep their names, and docs whose covers use the old name read Unlinked until you change them.
settings.repos.badName: Use 1–40 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit.

settings.repos.worktreeRootHint: New worktrees go here; existing ones stay where they are.
settings.repos.badRoot: Pick a full path outside the repo's main checkout.
settings.repos.scripts.localHint: Kept on this computer and run without asking. Setup runs after a worktree is created, archive before it is removed.
settings.repos.scripts.trustNote: Trust covers this command text only, not the files it runs.
settings.repos.file.hint: Read only. Edit the file in the editor; xDev asks before it uses a changed list.
settings.repos.identity.color.hint: Shown as a small badge on the project's heading and chips. A custom colour is #rgb or #rrggbb.
settings.repos.identity.badColor: Use a colour from the list or a hex like #3a7 or #33aa77.
settings.repos.identity.badIcon: The icon must be one emoji.
settings.repos.gh.goneNote: This login is no longer in gh. Pull request and issue calls for this project fail until you sign in again or pick another login.
settings.repos.gh.unavailable: The gh logins could not be read: {error}
settings.repos.gh.hint: Every gh call xDev makes for this project runs as this login. No token is stored; gh is asked on each call.

settings.repos.issue.tooLarge: The issue command is over 64 KiB.
settings.repos.issue.hint: The prompt sent to the agent when a worktree starts from an issue; {name} is filled from the issue and any other {x} stays as typed. It is a prompt, not a shell command. This machine's text wins; the shared one is used only after you trust it.
settings.repos.issue.sample.title: Footer meter overflows
settings.repos.issue.sample.body: The meter runs past the footer on narrow windows.
settings.vaults.title: Vaults
settings.vaults.intro: A repo vault is the docs folder in a repo's main checkout. A shared vault is a folder of its own; its covers name a repo, such as xdev:crates/**.
settings.vaults.forgetBody: xDev stops listing {path}. The folder and its docs stay on disk.
settings.agents.title: Agents
settings.agents.intro: How each agent CLI starts in a new tab, and which shells the + menu offers.
settings.agents.approvals.askHint: Agents ask before they edit files or run commands.
settings.agents.approvals.skipHint: Agents that follow this switch act without asking. xDev still asks you before each start.
settings.agents.skipBody: Agents that follow Approvals will edit files and run commands without asking first. xDev asks you before every start.
settings.agents.name: Name
settings.agents.argsHint: One per line. Any argument or variable opts out of Approvals.
settings.agents.startupHint: Run in the tab's shell before the CLI, one per line.
settings.agents.accountSwitch.label: When switching accounts with agents running
settings.agents.accountSwitch.hint: Applies to agent tabs that started under the active account. A restart ends the turn that is running and resumes the conversation under the new account.
settings.agents.accountSwitch.askHint: A dialog lists the running tabs and you choose which to restart.
settings.agents.accountSwitch.restartHin: Every running tab on the old account restarts at once.
settings.agents.accountSwitch.keepHint: Running tabs stay on the old account until you restart them.
settings.agents.sessionSearch.label: Search inside conversations
settings.agents.sessionSearch.hint: Reads what you and the agents wrote in the CLI logs and keeps the text in a separate index on this machine. Nothing leaves it. Tool calls and their results are left out. Turning it off deletes the index.
sessionSearch.clear.title: Clear search data?
sessionSearch.clear.body: This deletes the conversation index and turns the search off. Your sessions are not touched.
settings.agents.statusHooks.label: Use status hooks
settings.agents.approvals.autoHint: Agents that offer it review their own approval requests for you. Others keep asking.
settings.agents.catalog.refreshHint: Re-read your shell PATH and re-detect installed agents
settings.agents.catalog.none: No agents detected on your PATH. Pick one to install later, or continue with a blank terminal.
settings.agents.default.missing: Saved as your default, but not detected right now
settings.agents.trust.title: Trust the folder when xDev starts an agent
settings.agents.trust.what: Before a new agent tab starts, xDev marks that folder as trusted in the agent's own settings, so the agent does not stop at its trust prompt. Only that one folder is added; your home folder and drive roots never are.
settings.agents.statusHooks.what: claude and codex tabs report when they need you or finish a turn.
settings.agents.statusHooks.hint: Applies to new agent tabs only. xDev passes the hooks as flags of each start and never writes into the CLIs' config folders. A changed setting asks for approval again at the next start.
settings.notifications.title: Notifications
settings.notifications.intro: How xDev tells you that an agent needs you, finished or failed in a tab you are not looking at.
settings.notifications.osHint: Only when the pane is not in view, unless Quiet when in view is off.
settings.notifications.soundHint: At most one sound every 2 seconds.
settings.notifications.bellHint: The header bell counts unread worktrees and lists their unread tabs.
settings.notifications.badgeHint: A dot on Windows, the number of unread worktrees on macOS and Linux.
settings.notifications.enabledHint: The master switch. Off, no event below raises anything.
settings.notifications.onNeedsInputHint: A question, a permission or an attention call.
settings.notifications.onFailedHint: The turn ended with an error.
settings.notifications.onBellHint: A BEL from a pane you are not looking at. Off by default.
settings.notifications.suppressWhenFocus: On, a pane you are looking at raises nothing. Off, it notifies too.
settings.notifications.channelsHint: A channel fires only when its event switch and its own switch are both on.
settings.notifications.testBody: If you can read this, OS notifications work.
settings.notifications.testFailed: The OS did not show the notification. Check that xDev may send notifications in the system settings.
settings.notifications.soundFileHint: Own sound: a wav, mp3 or ogg file of at most 1 MB.

settings.terminal.osc52ClipboardHint: Programs in a pane may write the clipboard (OSC 52). They can never read it.

settings.terminal.service.hint: Terminals run in a service of their own and keep running when xDev closes, updates or crashes. Takes effect the next time xDev starts.

settings.terminal.theme.hint: One scheme for every terminal pane; open panes change at once.
